findings.reason: This signal is the trigger output of a sequence detector checking for specific 128-bit values and is used to enable a side-channel leakage payload.
This instance of Trojan_Trigger implements a multi-stage state machine that triggers only when a highly specific sequence of 128-bit state values is observed.
This instance of TSC acts as a Trojan payload that leaks internal round keys via power/timing side-channels when activated by Tj_Trig.
